definitions.ratio: Each candidate Total_Score or Total_Decision_Time divided by its own paired official-Naive value; lower is better.
definitions.mean: Arithmetic mean of the 32 per-case ratios, equal case weights; not ratio of sums and not capped dataset scores.
definitions.P50: Ordinary median, arithmetic mean of the middle pair for even n.
definitions.P90: Nearest rank: sorted value at ceil(0.90*n), using all n cases.
definitions.zero_denominator: 0/0 is 1; positive/0 is Infinity, retained in the population.
definitions.families: Declared metadata scenario (R48), category (R54), or parameters.family (R58), prefixed by origin round. Each row binds its metadata field, path and SHA.
definitions.family_limits: Small groups describe these observed synthetic cases, not statistical confidence or the unknown official distribution.
definitions.repeated_runs: One measured repeat per method/case. No cross-round fine timing ranking. Windows wall, WSL wall and GNU resource clocks remain separate.
